defective_pattern: Omitting the 'یادداشت.' prefix from table notes or leaving English prose (English leakage) inside the note body.
why_defective: Violates Persian APA 7th Edition guidelines which mandate the specific 'یادداشت.' prefix, and violates the zero-inline-Latin directive for Persian academic narrative.
observed_symptoms: Table notes beginning directly with text instead of 'یادداشت.'
English phrases or sentences appearing in the table note rather than Persian translation or transliteration
corrective_remedy: Prefix every table note with 'یادداشت. ' (italicized where applicable) and fully translate or transliterate all English explanatory text into Persian. Only retain Latin script for universal statistical symbols (e.g., *p*, *M*).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Regex detecting table notes that lack the prefix or contain English alphabetical characters in the explanatory prose.
